steps.say: A compass shows four directions: north, east, south and west.
On a map, north is usually at the top and south is at the bottom.
East is on the right and west is on the left.

figure.alt: A grid with point H and point S, 3 squares to the right of H.

steps.show: S is 3 squares east of H

steps.say: Clockwise turns go the same way as the hands of a clock.
A quarter turn clockwise from north faces east.

check.prompt: Nadia faces north and makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does Nadia face now?

options.why: South is a half turn from north.
West is a quarter turn anticlockwise from north.
Nadia faces north again only after a whole turn.

hints: Clockwise goes the same way as clock hands.
Picture the compass with north at the top.
Turn one quarter of the way round.
check.explanation: A quarter turn clockwise from north faces east.

check.prompt: North is at the top of the grid. In which direction is S from H?

options.why: West is to the left. S is straight above H.
East is to the right. S is straight above H.
South is down the grid. S is above H.

hints: North is at the top of the grid.
Start at H and move to S.
Do you move up, down, left or right?
check.explanation: S is straight above H. Up is north, so S is north of H.

figure.alt: A grid with point H and point S, 3 squares above H.
